title: Fast-path observability checklist for experimental rollouts
content:
Purpose
-----
This is a compact, operational-first checklist to use when we do small/medium experimental rollouts (canary or feature-flagged) that need fast telemetry coverage without full instrument overhaul. Focus: detect major regressions (latency, token cost, error rate), give operators quick drill paths, and limit query cost. Not a replacement for the full rollout playbook — this is the fast path for experiments where shipping speed matters.

How to use this doc
-------------------
- Run through the checklist 24–48h before canary and again immediately after start.
- Owners: feature PM + experiment owner (dev) + oncall ops contact.
- Keep changes minimal: prefer toggles and sampling over heavy new metrics.

Quick checklist (must-hit items)
--------------------------------
1) Define the experiment SLOs (1–3 items). Examples: p95 latency <= baseline p95 + 20%, token cost delta <= +10%, error rate increase <= 0.2pp.
2) Create a focused probe: 1 synthetic probe that runs the canonical request path at a ~1m cadence and a lightweight variant for high-contention flows. Tag probe with experiment_id.
3) Trace sampling policy: enable 100% trace capture for probe sessions; enable 5–10% sampling for real traffic for first 6h, revert to normal after stability window.
4) Metric delta set: ensure the following metrics exist and are returning data for the feature routes:
   - inference.request.count (route=*, experiment_id=*)
   - inference.request.errors (error_class, severity)
   - inference.latency.p50/p95/p99 (percentiles by route and tenant)
   - tokens.generated.total and tokens.user.total (token accounting by route)
   - kvcache.hit_ratio (per model variant)
   - queue.depth and worker.utilization (capacity safety)
5) Dash panels: small focused dashboard with 6 tiles: probe status, p95 latency delta (route), error rate delta, token cost per request, kvcache warmth, top-3 slow spans. Keep time window 30m/2h/24h selectable.
6) Alerts: create ephemeral alerts scoped to experiment_id with relaxed dedupe (single notify) for: p95 latency breach, error rate spike, token cost > threshold. Attach runbook link.
7) Runbook card: single-paragraph action card for oncall: "If probe fails — rollback; if p95 > threshold but tokens OK — scale/inspect kvcache; if errors spike — gather last 3 traces and open OBS-2345."

Compact metric definitions (operational wording)
------------------------------------------------
- inference.request.count: count of incoming inference requests. Include labels: route, tenant, experiment_id, model_variant. Use delta per minute.
- inference.request.errors: count grouped by error_class (validation, model, infra), severity (warning, critical). Prefer counting 5xx-like error classes under model/infra.
- inference.latency.p95: 95th percentile of service-side request-to-first-response for tokenized flows; bucket by route and model_variant. Note: p95 sensitive to sampling; ensure synthetic probe included.
- tokens.generated.total: tokens emitted by model. Important for cost deltas during rollouts. Use per-request average and sum.
- kvcache.hit_ratio: (kv_hits)/(kv_hits+kv_misses) measured at request end, label by model_variant and host_pool. Useful to detect cold-cache regressions.

Tracing guidance (short & practical)
-----------------------------------
- Trace naming: use span tag trace.experiment_id and span.resource=route. This makes trace filtering cheap.
- Sampling policy: for an experiment, temporarily bump sampling to 100% for synthetic probe traces and 5–10% for user traffic. Use severity-weighted retention (keep probe traces longer).
- Trace anchors to show on dashboard: model.forward span (time tokens built), pre/post kvcache span, network/serialize spans. Display top slow spans in panel.
- Trace size protection: cap trace capture at 500 spans or 1 MB; if too big, capture summary + breadcrumb.

Dashboard notes (design for fast ops)
------------------------------------
- Keep it to single-screen mobile-friendly grid (6 panels). Titles: Probe OK / failed, Latency delta vs baseline, Error rate delta, Token cost per req, KV Warmth, Top slow spans (trace links).
- Color rules: only use amber/red on deltas crossing threshold; avoid noisy minor fluctuations.
- Widget time ranges: default 30m; allow quick pivots to 2h and 24h. Keep panel queries cheap (no large joins).

Investigations quickcard (for first 15 minutes)
----------------------------------------------
1) Check probe status and synthetic trace. If probe trace shows kv miss in first token -> suspect cold-cache.
2) If p95 increased but median stable -> look at tail spans (model.forward or queue wait).
3) If tokens per req jumped -> verify prompt/template change, or model variant cost difference.
4) If errors spike -> fetch 3 recent traces, note error_class label, grep recent deploys/PRs.

Runbook snippets (copy-paste)
----------------------------
- Rollback command: feature-toggle set --env=prod --flag=<flag> --state=off (link to internal tool)
- Revert model variant: rollout manager -> swap to stable model variant, wait 2 slots 
- Collect traces: obs-cli trace fetch --filter "experiment_id=<id>" --limit 20 > /tmp/traces.json

Cost-control tips for experiments
--------------------------------
- Use sampled telemetry for 24h after rollout to limit trace storage.
- Prefer aggregated token counters over per-token logs.
- Set dashboard queries to 1m resolution by default; higher-resolution only for probe traces.

Outstanding questions / decisions
--------------------------------
- What should the canonical token-cost threshold be for new model variants? (TBD by pricing team)
- Do we allow auto-increasing trace sampling if an alert fires? (safety/PII concerns)
- Ownership: who marks ephemeral alerts as resolved and removes them from alerting rules? Suggest experiment owner.

Notes to self / rough TODOs
--------------------------
- Wire a shortcut to create ephemeral dashboards pre-populated with experiment_id filter (obs-infra ticket).
- Add a tiny UI affordance in console to mark route as "experiment" so metrics auto-label.
- Draft a template for the probe synthetic request for conversational vs. stateless routes.

References/links
---------------
- JIRA: OBS-2345 (experiment telemetry task)
- Confluence: OBS-FASTPATH-12 (full rollout checklist)
- GitHub: repo/instrumentation#78 (probe bootstrap PR)
